title: Missing settlement rows at Marlowe Payments, 31 August to 8 September 2026
summary: Merchants report payouts that never arrived. Reconciliation finds settlement advices that Marlowe acknowledged with a 2xx response and for which no ledger row exists. Several subsystems returned nothing when queried during the investigation; the records below state, for each subsystem, what was collected and how it was collected.

entities.note: Operates the settlement and ledger platform for 4,180 merchants.

entities.note: Streaming replica used by reporting workloads.

entities.name: settlement_batch_v2
entities.note: flagd flag controlling merchant enrolment in instalment settlement.

entities.name: ledger-vacuum

nodes.text: Merchant enrolment in settlement_batch_v2 instalment settlement.
Several advices of equal amount delivered for one merchant within one settlement date.
Idempotency key in svc-settlement-api built without the CardNet advice identifier.
Settlement advices acknowledged with a 2xx response for which ledger.settlements holds no row.
Deployment of avro-serde 1.14.2 in the svc-ledger-writer image.
Rebalance activity on consumer group ledger-writer-cg.
Row removal by ledger-vacuum over direct database sessions.
Memory exhaustion of otel-collector on 2 September.
No span naming the duplicate-suppression branch anywhere in the window.
Reconciliation reporting settlement rows as missing.
CardNet at-least-once delivery with retry until a 2xx response is returned.
Duplicate suppression at the Marlowe settlement ingress.

evidence.source: support-desk export, ticket sweep
evidence.text: Between 2026-08-31 and 2026-09-08, 41 merchants opened tickets for payouts that did not arrive. Reconciliation identifies 218 CardNet settlement advices that Marlowe acknowledged with a 2xx response and for which ledger.settlements holds no row. Marlowe acknowledged 54,300 advices in that window in total.

evidence.source: incident note IN-3318, Dana Ilves
evidence.text: Opening note on IN-3318: 'svc-ledger-writer began rejecting advices when CardNet added the optional network_token_ref attribute on 31 August. Nothing else changed that week. Roll the writer back and reprocess the window.'

evidence.source: cohort analysis, Priya Raghunathan
evidence.text: Of the 41 merchants reporting missing payouts, 39 are enrolled in the settlement_batch_v2 cohort, which covers 612 of 4,180 merchants. The remaining two, M-7781 and M-8003, are not enrolled and carry no tokenised card volume.

evidence.source: reconciliation join against gateway request index
evidence.text: Of the 216 missing advices attributed to cohort merchants, every one falls on a merchant-day on which the gateway handled two or more advices for that merchant. Across 3,914 cohort merchant-days carrying exactly one advice, no advice is missing a ledger row.

evidence.source: flagd audit log and CardNet programme description
evidence.text: settlement_batch_v2 reached 30 percent rollout at 2026-08-31T06:00Z. Enrolment registers a merchant for instalment settlement, under which CardNet delivers that merchant's daily payout as several advices of equal amount rather than one aggregate advice.

evidence.source: Prometheus, scrape target svc-ledger-writer
evidence.text: settlement_rejected_total{service="svc-ledger-writer"} is registered at process start and exported on every scrape whether or not it has moved. It read 0 on all scrapes from 2026-08-31 to 2026-09-08. Two counters from the same registry, ledger_rows_written_total and schema_registry_fetch_total, advanced throughout the window, and the scrape target records no gaps for that job.

evidence.source: Tomas Berg, log and instrumentation review
evidence.text: A search of svc-settlement-api logs across the window returns no entries from the duplicate-suppression branch. Reviewing the branch in source: its only emission is a log.Debug call, the production fleet runs with LOG_LEVEL=info, the branch registers no counter, and it opens no span.

evidence.source: edge-gw access-log excerpt pasted into ticket MP-9921 on 2026-09-05
evidence.text: Merchant M-4412 on 2026-09-03: three POSTs to /v1/cardnet/advice at 02:14:07Z, 02:14:09Z and 02:14:11Z, each carrying amount_minor 1284500 and a distinct advice_id, each answered 200 by svc-settlement-api.

evidence.source: direct query of pg-ledger-primary and topic dump of settlement.events.v3
evidence.text: pg-ledger-primary holds exactly one row for M-4412 dated 2026-09-03 with amount_minor 1284500. Topic settlement.events.v3 holds exactly one produced event for that merchant and date, produced 4 ms after the first of the three POSTs. Topic retention covers the whole window.

evidence.source: svc-settlement-api v3.41.0, internal/ledger/idem.go
evidence.text: The idempotency key is sha256 over merchant_id, amount_minor and settlement_date joined by a separator. On a key hit the handler returns the stored 200 response and does not produce to settlement.events.v3. The CardNet advice_id is persisted on the record but is not an input to the key.

evidence.source: svc-settlement-api schema review, table idem_keys
evidence.text: Table idem_keys stores one row per idempotency key together with the stored response body. A row is created on first use and re-read on later hits without being modified; the table carries no hit counter and no hit timestamp. A nightly job prunes rows to a 14-day horizon and no export of the table was taken before the prune.

evidence.source: kf-settle-prod broker event log and platform runbook
evidence.text: Consumer group ledger-writer-cg recorded 47 rebalances on 2026-09-04 between 09:00Z and 11:20Z following a broker restart. The platform runbook lists rebalance storms among the known causes of settlement processing faults.

evidence.source: daily breakdown of reconciliation output
evidence.text: Missing advices are spread across all nine days of the window, between 14 and 38 per day, including 2026-09-01 and 2026-09-07. No rebalance events are recorded for ledger-writer-cg on either of those dates.

evidence.source: replication dashboard and recon.yaml in the deployment repository
evidence.text: pg-ledger-replica-b reported replication lag peaking at 14 minutes on 2026-09-06 during an index rebuild. recon.yaml sets target: primary for the reconciliation job and has not been modified since 2026-04-17.

evidence.source: deployment record and schema-registry check history
evidence.text: The svc-ledger-writer image deployed at 2026-08-31T05:40Z upgraded avro-serde from 1.13.6 to 1.14.2, twenty minutes before the flag rollout. The schema-registry compatibility check for settlement.events.v3 version 7 passed at that deploy and at every deploy since.

evidence.source: otel-collector pod events and trace store query
evidence.text: otel-collector was OOM-killed twice on 2026-09-02 and an estimated 6 percent of spans for that date were dropped. No span naming the duplicate-suppression branch of svc-settlement-api appears on any date in the window.

evidence.source: audit-trail query and interceptor design note
evidence.text: audit-trail records no DELETE events against ledger.settlements in the window. Its capture is an application interceptor inside svc-ledger-writer; statements issued over direct database sessions do not pass through that interceptor and are therefore not offered to audit-trail at all.

evidence.source: ledger-vacuum job definition, batch-namespace log policy, pg_stat_user_tables
evidence.text: ledger-vacuum connects as role svc_maint over a direct session. Its run summary reports partitions scanned and elapsed time and reports no row counts, and container logs in the batch namespace are retained for 72 hours. pg_stat_user_tables.n_tup_del is a cumulative table counter that attributes no statement, table partition or time to any change it records, and it was reset by the primary failover on 2026-09-05.

evidence.source: CardNet integration specification section 4.2 and Marlowe 2025 integration sign-off
evidence.text: CardNet delivers each advice at least once and retries it up to five times across 30 minutes until a 2xx response is returned. Marlowe's 2025 integration sign-off records duplicate suppression at ingress as the compensating control for that delivery behaviour, and records that payouts are released from ledger rows without a second uniqueness check.

evidence.source: CardNet ticket CN-88214 reply, annotated by Marisol Okafor
evidence.text: CardNet support reply of 2026-09-12: 'Our platform transmits one settlement advice per merchant per settlement date.' Marisol Okafor's annotation records that the reply came from tier-1 support and makes no reference to the instalment settlement programme.

evidence.source: CardNet ticket CN-88397 and vendor portal retention policy
evidence.text: Ticket CN-88397, requesting CardNet transmission manifests covering 2026-08-31 to 2026-09-08, was filed on 2026-09-14. The CardNet portal retains manifests for seven days, Marlowe holds no copy of any manifest for the window, and no response to CN-88397 is recorded.

evidence.source: edge-gw Envoy configuration history and metric store
evidence.text: edge-gw exports gw_requests_total with a route label. The label value cardnet_advice was introduced in the Envoy configuration released on 2026-09-09; before that date requests on the advice path were counted under route="other" together with eleven further routes, and the aggregate cannot be decomposed after the fact.

evidence.source: edge-gw archive retention policy
evidence.text: The edge-gw access-log archive is retained for seven days. Entries from 2026-08-31 to 2026-09-02 were already past retention when the investigation opened on 2026-09-10. The M-4412 excerpt survives only because an engineer pasted it into ticket MP-9921 on 2026-09-05.

evidence.source: reconciliation output, per-merchant breakdown
evidence.text: M-7781 and M-8003 account for two of the 218 missing advices, dated 2026-09-01 and 2026-09-02 respectively. Both dates fall outside the retained access-log archive. Neither merchant was due more than one payout on the date concerned.

hypotheses.text: Duplicate suppression in svc-settlement-api treats instalment advices that share a merchant, an amount and a settlement date as repeats of one another, acknowledging the later advices without producing a settlement event.

svc-ledger-writer rejects advices carrying the optional network_token_ref attribute introduced by CardNet on 31 August, so those advices are consumed from the topic without a ledger row being written.
Rebalances on consumer group ledger-writer-cg advance committed offsets past advices that svc-ledger-writer had read but not yet written, leaving those advices consumed and unrecorded in the ledger.
CardNet did not transmit the settlement advices that merchants M-7781 and M-8003 report as missing, so no corresponding request reached the Marlowe edge gateway on 1 and 2 September.

The ledger-vacuum maintenance job removes settlement rows from ledger.settlements inside the incident window over direct database sessions, so rows written during processing no longer appear in the ledger.
Reconciliation queries pg-ledger-replica-b while replication lag is elevated and reports rows as missing that are present on pg-ledger-primary, producing the 218 advices recorded without ledger rows.

edges.text: Enrolment in instalment settlement causes several advices of equal amount within one merchant-day.
An idempotency key built without the advice identifier causes acknowledged advices to hold no ledger row.
The avro-serde 1.14.2 deployment causes acknowledged advices to hold no ledger row.
Rebalance activity on ledger-writer-cg causes acknowledged advices to hold no ledger row.
Row removal by ledger-vacuum causes acknowledged advices to hold no ledger row.
Memory exhaustion of otel-collector explains the absence of duplicate-suppression spans across the window.
Replication lag on pg-ledger-replica-b causes reconciliation to report settlement rows as missing.
CardNet at-least-once delivery with retry requires duplicate suppression at the Marlowe settlement ingress.

actions.text: Add a persistent counter and an info-level record to the duplicate-suppression branch of svc-settlement-api, deploy across the production fleet, and re-examine a week of settlement traffic once that branch reports.

Extend the idempotency key in svc-settlement-api to combine the CardNet advice identifier with merchant, amount and settlement date, then replay into the ledger those advices for the window that remain available.
Disable the merchant, amount and date suppression step in svc-settlement-api for merchants in the batch cohort, so that each advice CardNet delivers for them is written to the ledger on receipt.

Rebuild the ledger partitions covering 31 August to 8 September from the edge-gw request archive, so that the contents of ledger.settlements match the requests the gateway recorded across that period.
Roll the svc-ledger-writer image back to avro-serde 1.13.6 across the production fleet, then re-run the settlement pipeline for 31 August to 8 September against the restored serialisation path.

Raise the consumer-group session timeout on kf-settle-prod and reduce the partition count of settlement.events.v3, so that rebalances on ledger-writer-cg no longer interrupt processing during peak settlement hours.
Escalate ticket CN-88397 with CardNet for the transmission manifests covering the window, and hold the M-7781 and M-8003 cases open until those manifests or an equivalent record arrive.

propositions.text: Advices rejected by schema validation in svc-ledger-writer between 2026-08-31 and 2026-09-08.
Advices suppressed by the duplicate check in svc-settlement-api between 2026-08-31 and 2026-09-08.
DELETE statements issued against ledger.settlements over direct database sessions between 2026-08-31 and 2026-09-08.
Advices transmitted by CardNet for merchants M-7781 and M-8003 on 2026-09-01 and 2026-09-02.
Advices of equal amount delivered for merchant M-4412 on 2026-09-03 beyond the first of them.
